_comment: MidAir semantic class ID → unified semantic class mapping for uav_nav.

_classes.rock: Rock / stone features — bare rocks, stones (Kite:6, PLE:6).
_classes.river: Water bodies — rivers, streams, lakes (Kite:8, PLE:8).
_classes.road: Road infrastructure — asphalt roads, railway tracks (PLE:10,11).

_ignored.1: animals (deer) — rare, not useful as landmark
_ignored.3: grass — not distinctive enough as landmark
_ignored.5: ambiguous hills/treetops — mixed terrain, unreliable label
_ignored.12: road signs — too small for reliable detection
